business_summary: TUS Environmental Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides environment improvement solutions in China. It offers digital sanitation services, including unmanned sanitation, domestic waste classification, green and smart properties, environmental sanitation, smart public toilets, and others; water-eco services, such as water investment, intelligent environmental protection, water environment products and equipment, water environment technology, supply chain business, and others; and organic solid waste services comprising kitchen waste, sludge treatment, tailing treatment, pretreatment, anaerobic fermentation, and others. It also provides zero-carbon energy services, which include research, planning, design development, investment and financing, EPC general contracting, operation, and maintenance of waste incineration and power generation, as well as upgradation of traditional waste incineration and disposal plants; and solid waste and renewable resources services, such as solid waste treatment and disposal, and renewable resources utilization. In addition, it offers TUS-EGUARD platform that is involved in the research, design, development, and manufacturing base for sanitation trucks and environmental protection equipment, comprising new energy devices, municipal vehicles, cleaning tankers, and garbage stations, as well as sweeping, garbage, and self-driving pure electric trucks. The company was formerly known as Tus-Sound Environmental Resources Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TUS Environmental Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd. in July 2019. TUS Environmental Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Yichang, China.
business_summary_ko: TUS Environmental Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 환경 개선 솔루션을 제공합니다. 무인 위생, 생활 폐기물 분류, 친환경 및 스마트 자산, 환경 위생, 스마트 공중 화장실 등을 포함한 디지털 위생 서비스를 제공합니다. 물 투자, 지능형 환경 보호, 물 환경 제품 및 장비, 물 환경 기술, 공급망 사업 등과 같은 물 환경 서비스; 주방 폐기물, 슬러지 처리, 광미 처리, 전처리, 혐기성 발효 등으로 구성된 유기성 고형 폐기물 서비스 등이 있습니다. 또한 연구, 계획, 설계 개발, 투자 및 자금 조달, EPC 일반 계약, 폐기물 소각 및 발전의 운영 및 유지 관리는 물론 기존 폐기물 소각 및 처리 공장의 업그레이드를 포함하는 제로 탄소 에너지 서비스를 제공합니다. 고형 폐기물 처리 및 처리, 재생 가능 자원 활용과 같은 고형 폐기물 및 재생 가능 자원 서비스. 또한 연구, 설계, 개발에 관련된 TUS-EGUARD 플랫폼을 제공합니다.
